definitions.gloss: branch line; spur line; feeder line
definitions.explanation: A secondary railway line, road, or cable that branches off from a main line. Most commonly refers to a smaller railway line that connects to a trunk line.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{支線|しせん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{乗|の}り{換|か}える→乗り換える：01194_norikaeru⟧。
examples.english: Transfer to the branch line at this station.

examples.japanese: {支線|しせん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{本数|ほんすう}→本数：13154_honsuu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{少|すく}ない→少ない：01136_sukunai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で⟦{時刻表|じこくひょう}→時刻表：01031_jikokuhyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}して→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: The branch line has few trains, so please check the timetable.

examples.japanese: ⟦{利用者|りようしゃ}→利用者：03189_riyousha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{減少|げんしょう}→減少：02719_genshou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧{支線|しせん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{廃止|はいし}→廃止：12483_haishi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{検討|けんとう}→検討：02710_kentou⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Discontinuation of the branch line is being considered due to declining ridership.

notes:
Compound of {支|し} ('branch; offshoot') and ⟦{線|せん}→線：09901_sen⟧ ('line; route'). The standard term for a secondary railway or cable line that branches off from the main (⟦{本線|ほんせん}→本線：22486_honsen⟧).

USAGE:
- In railway terminology, {支線|しせん} contrasts with ⟦{本線|ほんせん}→本線：22486_honsen⟧ ('main line'). Branch lines typically serve smaller communities and run less frequently.
- Also used for telecommunications and electrical wiring: a {支線|しせん} branches from the main cable to serve individual buildings or areas.
- Many rural {支線|しせん} in Japan face closure due to population decline and low ridership — a recurring topic in regional news.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {支線|しせん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{乗|の}り{換|か}える→乗り換える：01194_norikaeru⟧: to transfer to a branch line
- {支線|しせん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{廃止|はいし}→廃止：12483_haishi⟧: discontinuation of a branch line
- ⟦{本線|ほんせん}→本線：22486_honsen⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{支線|しせん}: main line and branch line

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{本線|ほんせん}→本線：22486_honsen⟧: main line; trunk line — the primary route from which branch lines diverge
- ⟦{路線|ろせん}→路線：11341_rosen⟧: route; line — the general term for a railway, bus, or airline route
- {単線|たんせん}: single-track line — a railway with only one track, common on branch lines
- ⟦{私鉄|してつ}→私鉄：00374_shitetsu⟧: private railway — a non-JR railway company, many of which operate branch lines
